documents.content: The first GasolineYield fit is yield ~ temp only. It uses an identity link for the mean and a log link with temperature covariates for precision. The batch indicators are not part of the published model.
The source reports precision 577.7907 before omission and 440.2783 after observation 4 is omitted, so fitted precision decreases after omission.

The increase in fitted precision proves that observation 4 caused the excess variance. It establishes that deleting influential observations is generally the best beta-regression procedure and validates the package's theory for all bounded responses.

Because Rplots.pdf exists, I visually verified that every diagnostic plot improved. A valid rerun must produce a PDF with the exact same SHA-256 bytes, and any different PDF hash invalidates otherwise identical numerical output.

Running the companion source with R 4.4.3 and selected historical package versions exactly reconstructs the authors' complete 2010 operating system, R, BLAS, graphics device, and dependency environment and fully replicates every result in the article.
